notes.title: KEY 2 NEW GAME! 50 HARD LEVELS, CRYSTAL LEVELS AND MORE!
notes.content:
- 50 more levels have been added, after you beat all 50 levels you can play them in hard mode by resetting the game by entering the hard mode door, the stages in hard mode have much less time than normal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290738/4664fb4d46b98b71b9dc77337c3e0312083ec985.png[/img]

- Now Key 2 is possible to play in all possible languages, as it uses keys that are not characters to perform actions.

- 3 Crystal Stages added, similar to the Crash game in which you need to collect all the crystals to win a relic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290738/f80dbca8c6624951d0cdebc6af13ed6c45ef0f96.png[/img]

- A challenge phase with lots of ice has been added to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290738/bfb7145ed63a7ef34ecc5a4ba1505be666493e0b.png[/img]

- A challenge stage with lots of spikes has been added to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290738/92ebe97f5d8b82e374bbefec07d5ad0913c2063b.png[/img]

- A low time level has been added to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290738/4656aa5fbf48b6bb02481cfd2cdac5a61e272582.png[/img]

notes.title: Coming soon Key 2
notes.content: key 2 is a maze game in which you have to find a key and then find out where the door is, a relaxing minimalist pixel art game, where in this version there are many improvements to Flow, such as more thorns along the way, less time to finish levels, enemies that move at 3 speeds and store to buy usable items and improvements.
